endpoints.description: Budgetary overview for a federal agency

limits.notes: No API key required. No published hard quota; be courteous with pagination (POST filters with page/limit).

llmDocs.summary: US federal government spending: contracts, grants, loans, and agency budgets, searchable by recipient, agency, location, and time.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Most search endpoints are POST with a JSON 'filters' object. Build filters (time_period, agencies, award_type_codes) and POST to /search/spending_by_award/.

exampleQueries.intent: Contract awards in FY2025 for one agency

gotchas: Keyless but most useful endpoints are POST, not GET
Filters object schema is strict — malformed filters return 422
Large result sets require pagination via page/limit

compliance.redistributionNotes: US federal data, public domain (DATA Act). Free to redistribute.
